title: Smaller than expected
text: Smaller than expected. So according to the package- the pan is -what I thought- 12.4 x 7.4.  So this measurement also includes the handles.  Which is strange - because that’s not actual cooking space.  Guess you really need to read the description.  The pans are nice looking.  I’m on the fence if I will keep it- it’s definitely NOT a pan for lasagna.
